name: Synn
message: 「If you pull this again, you're not getting any dinner!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Much obliged. Not a scratch on me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know, you really ought to keep your scheming in moderation.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Truly. All I wish for is to enjoy a harmonious academy life with Rii-a, yet...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I just might end up falling for you, President.」
Misasagi-senpai is normally cheerful and never without a smile.
Even though being a high-class young lady is a position anyone would envy, she probably carries hidden hardships of her own.
If there's anything we can do, I want to help her out as much as possible.

name: Helena
message: 「Well said, Synn-chan! I'll give you this!」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, a situation like this is what dreams are made of... Suspense & action!!」

name: Helena
message: 「I want a rugged older gentleman to protect me too...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, who on earth is the culprit...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Probably one of my fiance candidates, I reckon.」
I came to realize that Misasagi-senpai's world exists in a realm completely beyond my comprehension.
